slides.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
slides.prompt: How should administrative route protection be enforced in enterprise APIs?
options: Via role verification claims embedded in authenticated JWT payloads or database checks
By relying on client-side frontend code to hide buttons
By using unencrypted HTTP basic auth headers
slides.correctAnswer: Via role verification claims embedded in authenticated JWT payloads or database checks

slides.title: Decoding JWT Claims
slides.prompt: Fill in the PyJWT method used to verify and decode access tokens.

slides.title: CORS Defense
slides.prompt: What is the primary function of Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) security headers?
options: Restricting which external web domains can make browser requests to your API
slides.correctAnswer: Restricting which external web domains can make browser requests to your API

slides.title: Rate Limiting Protection
slides.prompt: Fill in the middleware term used to limit excessive client request rates to prevent DDoS attacks.

slides.title: SQL Injection Prevention
slides.prompt: How do modern Python ORMs like SQLAlchemy protect against SQL injection vulnerabilities?
options: By using parameterized queries and prepared statements automatically
By escaping string input with regular expressions on the frontend
By converting raw SQL into JSON objects
By running database engines in read-only mode
slides.correctAnswer: By using parameterized queries and prepared statements automatically
